head: ai-replay-budget-r3
report:
Core file first.

Copy the prior probes into scratch and replay them against this head.

NO DEFECTS

## NOT A DEFECT

**Earlier findings, replayed at this head.** I copied the round-two probes (`send-gaps.test.ts`, `adversarial.test.ts`, `lanes.ts`) into scratch unchanged and ran them against eef64a4f.

| Earlier finding | Status | What I saw |
|---|---|---|
| Vertex sends a regional-404 fallback with budget 0 (`google-shared.ts`) | Closed | `openStream` now calls `replayBudget.replayAfter(...)` before the global URL. `vertex-zero-fallback`: 1 request, regional URL only, marker set. |
| Send-time check runs before work that uses up the budget: outer attempt preparation | Closed | `outer-late-prepare` with a 700 ms budget and a 900 ms payload hook. openai-completions: prepares 2, requests 1, marker set. azure-openai-responses: the six immediate in-attempt retries go out within 18 ms; the late outer replay is refused; marker set. The handoff gate in `transportFetch`/`gateFetch` and the arm in `withReplaySafeStreamRetry` now refuse the late send. |
| Send-time check runs before work that uses up the budget: Codex observer | Closed | `codex-late-observer`, budget 800 ms: observes 2, requests 1, marker set. |
| Shortest named wait wins: conflicting headers, `x-ratelimit-reset-after`, repeated or malformed body hints | Closed | `three-headers`, `repeated-body-hint`, `malformed-body-beside-valid`, `different-body-hints`, `long-header-short-body` and `malformed-header-beside-valid`: every lane sent 1 request, marked. `longestRetryHint` reads every header value and every match in the body, and `x-ratelimit-reset-after` is now among the headers it reads. |
| Shortest named wait wins: a reasoning correction with `retry-after: 30` resent at once | Closed | `hinted-correction`: 1 send, marked. |
| A wait hook that never settles can hold the call | Closed | `ReplayBudget.wait` now races the hook against a deadline timer and the abort signal. The old characterization test expected the call still pending at 1 s, so it now fails as expected: `settled: true`, 1 request, about 1005 ms elapsed. |
| Unconditional first resume GET, and the marker set when the correction limit stops the call | Still closed | These were closed in round two. I did not rerun those probes. |
| Hinted 401 responses must neither replay nor be marked | Still holds | `nonretryable-hinted`: 1 request, unmarked, on all 8 lanes. |

Totals: `send-gaps.test.ts` 4 pass / 0 fail. `adversarial.test.ts` passed every case except the one stale never-wait characterization above.

**Suspicions I checked and ruled out.**
- **A credential retry might get a fresh budget.** I suspected that a `streamSimple` call with a key resolver (the coding-agent path through `agent-loop.ts`) builds one `ReplayBudget` in `streamSimpleRequest` and another in each attempt's `mapOptionsForApi`. Ruled out: `withTransportFetch` calls `withReplayBudget` first, so `requestOptions` already carries the shared budget. The spread `attemptOptions` and `inheritReplayBudget` pass that same budget on.
- **Leftover arm after a refused fetch retry.** In `fetchWithRetry`, when `retryGate(0)` refuses a held response, the arm that `admits` set is never consumed. Ruled out: the call ends with the held failure and nothing else is sent, so the leftover arm has no effect.
- **The coding-agent held budget reaching the wrong request.** `consumeHeldRetryReplayBudget` is read only in the agent-loop `streamFn`, not in side-channel requests or the cache warmer. It is matched to the target `provider/id` and cleared at saga reset and retry end. This follows the existing `consumeActiveFallbackCreditRedemption` pattern.
- **`withReplaySafeStreamRetry` restoring a refused replay.** The held attempt's buffered events are pushed only on that restore path; normal retries never flush them. An attempt that already set `replayBudgetExhausted` stops further empty and provider-error retries, so the budget is not spent twice.
- **Thinking-loop re-sample and auth retry.** Both arm the budget, see `arm.refused` after a refused handoff, and keep the earlier failure with the marker set.
- **The patch's own tests.** `replay-budget.test.ts`, `replay-budget-wire.test.ts`, `stream-auth-retry.test.ts` and `empty-completion-retry.test.ts`: 184 pass, 0 fail.
- **Environment.** The probes first failed to resolve modules because scratch sits outside the workspace. I fixed that with a `node_modules` symlink in scratch pointing at the snapshot's `node_modules`; nothing in the snapshot was written. I did not rerun the coding-agent suite or the 49-second end-to-end measurement in this window.
